english.title: Exceed a 50mph speed restriction on a special road / motorway - automatic camera device

english.legislation: Contrary to the above regulations and section 17(2), (3) and (4) of the Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
